title: Android Engineer
description:
Facer, the world’s largest watch face platform for smartwatches, is looking for an iOS engineer to help develop and ship features for its Android and wearOS apps.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Lead the future of smartwatches and build new features for Facer's Android mobile and WearOS watch apps.

  • Collaborate with Facer's engineering team on large scale efforts spanning the whole Facer platform

  • Participate in a very collaborative team effort to deliver the best experience possible to our users.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU!

  • Computer Science degree (BS or MS), or proof of involvement in large scale mobile apps

  • Conversant in Java and Kotlin

  • Experience in OpenGL is a plus

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills

  • Highly organized, self-starter with attention to detail

SOUNDS AMAZING! WHAT NOW!?

Interviews are set to begin immediately. Go ahead and apply today!
